EQM00007.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="bold-italic">e</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo fence="true">(</mo><mtable rowspacing="0.16em" columnalign="center" columnspacing="1em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo fence="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\boldsymbol e_{x'}=\begin{pmatrix}\cos\theta\\\sin\theta\end{pmatrix}</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00009.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi mathvariant="bold-italic">e</mi><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup></msub><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo fence="true">(</mo><mtable rowspacing="0.16em" columnalign="center" columnspacing="1em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>90</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>90</mn><mo>∘</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo fence="true">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mrow><mo fence="true">(</mo><mtable rowspacing="0.16em" columnalign="center" columnspacing="1em"><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mrow><mo>−</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr><mtr><mtd><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow></mstyle></mtd></mtr></mtable><mo fence="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\boldsymbol e_{y'}=\begin{pmatrix}\cos(\theta+90^\circ)\\\sin(\theta+90^\circ)\end{pmatrix}=\begin{pmatrix}-\sin\theta\\\cos\theta\end{pmatrix}</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00014.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>X</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">X=x'\cos\theta-y'\sin\theta\qquad(1)</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00015.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mi>Y</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">Y=x'\sin\theta+y'\cos\theta\qquad(2)</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00017.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">=(x'\cos\theta-y'\sin\theta)\cos\theta+(x'\sin\theta+y'\cos\theta)\sin\theta</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00018.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><msup><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>θ</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><msup><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">=x'\cos^2\theta-y'\sin\theta\cos\theta+x'\sin^2\theta+y'\cos\theta\sin\theta</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00022.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">=-(x'\cos\theta-y'\sin\theta)\sin\theta+(x'\sin\theta+y'\cos\theta)\cos\theta</annotation></semantics></math>

EQM00023.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" display="block"><semantics><mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><msup><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>θ</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><msup><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>θ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">=-x'\cos\theta\sin\theta+y'\sin^2\theta+x'\sin\theta\cos\theta+y'\cos^2\theta</annotation></semantics></math>
